tray.stillRunningMsg: ABS Desktop App keeps playing in the tray. Right-click the tray icon to quit.
connect.subtitle: Enter the address of your Audiobookshelf server.
connect.label: Server address
connect.err.unreachable: Couldn't reach that address. Check the server is running and the address and port are right.
connect.err.notAbs: That address answered, but it isn't an Audiobookshelf server. Wrong port? Audiobookshelf's default is 13378.
connect.err.badAddress: That doesn't look like a server address.
update.newMsg: ABS Desktop App {version} is available (you have {current}).
update.upToDateMsg: ABS Desktop App {version} is the newest version.
update.failedMsg: Check your internet connection and try again.
app.clearCacheMsg: This empties the app's stored web files and restarts it. Your server, saved login and settings are kept.
help.diagCopiedMsg: Paste them into your bug report. They contain no passwords, usernames or server address.
app.restartMsg: The change takes effect after ABS Desktop App restarts. Restart now?
update.installMsg: Install now downloads it, checks it and restarts ABS Desktop App on the new version. Your settings and login are kept.
update.installFailedMsg: Nothing was changed. Try again later, or download it from the release page.
update.verifyFailed: The downloaded file didn't match the published fingerprint, so it was deleted and nothing was changed.
app.shortcutDone: A shortcut to ABS Desktop App is now on your desktop. It keeps working after updates.
temp.title: This is a temporary copy
issues.confirm: Remove all {n} books with issues from this library? Files on disk are not deleted.
issues.noProgress: None of them has listening progress or bookmarks.
issues.withProgress: {n} of them have listening progress or bookmarks, which will be deleted:
player.closedOther: Closed “{title}” here: it's playing on another device ({device}).
offline.title: Offline library
offline.empty: No books are downloaded yet. Open a book and press the download button next to Play to keep it for listening without your server.
offline.removeConfirm: Remove the offline copy of “{title}”? It frees {size}. The book stays on your server.
offline.errNoAudio: this book has no audio to download
offline.synced: Your offline listening was saved to the server.
offline.pending: Your listening is saved here and goes to your server when you're back online.
offline.autoDelete: Remove offline copies of finished books
offline.autoOpen: Open the offline library when the server can't be reached
offline.removeAllDetail: The books stay on your server; only the copies on this PC are removed.
offline.removeAllPending: Some listening done offline hasn't reached your server yet and will be lost. Open the app while your server is reachable first to send it.
offline.autoDeleted: You finished “{title}”, so its offline copy was removed.
offline.seriesRemoveConfirm: Remove the offline copies of all {count} books in “{series}”? It frees {size}. The books stay on your server.
offline.startNote: Your server can't be reached right now, so here are your downloaded books. Press “Back to the server” to try again.
